purpose: Read-only template for proving native Codex preservation, raw bypass availability, wrapper smoke evidence, and rollback evidence before production marking.

field_descriptions.gate_id: Stable identifier for a concrete release-gate evidence record.
field_descriptions.target_repository: Repository root that owns the source, OpenSpec artifacts, and release evidence.
field_descriptions.release_version: Release slice or version label being evaluated, such as R0.6.1.
field_descriptions.operator_consent_boundary: Boundary between read-only checks and any explicit operator-approved user-level mutation.
field_descriptions.native_codex_entrypoint: Evidence that native Codex still launches through codex --version.
field_descriptions.raw_bypass_entrypoint: Evidence that codex-raw still launches the native Codex bypass path.
field_descriptions.wrapped_entrypoint: Evidence that codex-ohmy wrapper starts or shows help without breaking daily use.
field_descriptions.installer_rollback_test: Repository test evidence for backup snapshots and rollback-on-error behavior.
field_descriptions.openspec_guard: Aggregate repository guard evidence, including OpenSpec validation and policy checkers.
field_descriptions.config_toml_sentinel: Evidence that config.toml rewrite detection or backup sentinel is checked before release.
field_descriptions.manual_rollback_path: Operator-visible restore path or backup snapshot evidence for manual version rollback.
field_descriptions.publication_rollback_path: GitLab/GitHub publication rollback path if a post-merge mirror or release tag must be reverted.

required_release_checks.description: Local smoke command proving the native Codex entrypoint still launches.
Local smoke command proving the stable raw Codex bypass still launches.
Local smoke command proving the stable wrapped Codex launcher does not fail immediately.
Repository test validating backup snapshots, unmanaged collision protection, native preservation, and rollback-on-error behavior.
Aggregate repository guard covering OpenSpec validation and policy checkers.

required_release_checks.command_or_path: Check C:\Users\lenovo\.codex\config.toml backup or rewrite sentinel before production marking.
required_release_checks.description: Operator evidence that Codex user config rewrite detection is checked before release.
Operator-visible backup snapshot or documented restore path for manual version rollback.

required_release_checks.command_or_path: GitLab main revert plus GitHub mirror resync if a published release must be rolled back.
required_release_checks.description: Publication rollback path for reverting a merged GitLab-first release and resyncing the GitHub mirror.

non_mutation_guards: Do not modify codex, codex.cmd, or codex.ps1 from this release gate.
Do not write C:\Users\lenovo\.codex\config.toml from this release gate.
Do not install into the real user Codex home without a separate reviewed change and explicit operator consent.
Do not launch durable teams, native_omx, or LangGraph runtime from this release gate.
